hiring_programs.name: NQT — Ninja Track
hiring_programs.overview: Focuses on foundational aptitude, core programming logic (Python/Java/C++), basic SQL, and HR cultural fit.

hiring_programs.name: NQT — Digital Track
hiring_programs.overview: Requires strong Data Structures & Algorithms, modern web/cloud concepts, microservices, and database indexing.
typical_rounds: In-Depth Technical Panel (System Concepts, DSA, Projects)

hiring_programs.name: NQT — Prime Track
hiring_programs.overview: Highest campus tier testing complex graph/tree algorithms, low-level architecture, scalability, and AI/ML foundations.
typical_rounds: Prime Coding Challenge (2 Hard DSA Questions)

hiring_programs.name: SDE I (Software Development Engineer)
hiring_programs.overview: Strict focus on LeetCode Medium/Hard DSA (Trees, Graphs, DP, Heap) and Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles (STAR method).
typical_rounds: Online Assessment (2 Coding Questions + Work Simulation)
Technical Round 2: Problem Solving & Object-Oriented Design
Bar Raiser: System Design + Leadership Principles

hiring_programs.name: SDE II
hiring_programs.overview: High-scale Distributed Systems Design (HLD/LLD), microservices, caching, concurrency, and deep ownership.

hiring_programs.name: Software Engineer (L3 / Campus)
hiring_programs.overview: World-class algorithmic problem solving, clean maintainable code without syntax errors, time/space complexity, and Googlyness.
typical_rounds: Technical Interview 2: Graph Theory & Dynamic Programming
Technical Interview 3: Algorithmic Efficiency & Edge Cases

hiring_programs.name: Software Engineer (New Grad / SDE)
hiring_programs.overview: Focuses on tree/graph algorithms, bit manipulation, modular code, OOP architecture, and collaborative problem solving.
typical_rounds: Technical Round 1: Data Structures & Problem Solving
Technical Round 2: Design Patterns & Object-Oriented Design

hiring_programs.name: Systems Engineer
hiring_programs.overview: Aptitude, reasoning, pseudocode debugging, and fundamental technical panel interview.

hiring_programs.name: Specialist Programmer (Power Programmer)
hiring_programs.overview: HackWithInfy / InfyTQ qualifier, competitive programming questions on DP, greedy, and trees.
typical_rounds: HackWithInfy Competitive Coding Qualifier (3 Hard Problems)
Technical Panel on Advanced Algorithms & Architecture

hiring_programs.name: Digital Specialist Engineer (DSE)
hiring_programs.overview: Full stack engineering, SQL, and intermediate algorithmic coding.
typical_rounds: Technical Interview on Projects & Database Design

hiring_programs.name: GenC
hiring_programs.overview: General aptitude, English communication, basic programming concepts, and behavioral alignment.

hiring_programs.name: GenC Elevate
hiring_programs.overview: Hands-on coding, SQL queries, OOP principles, and project deep dive.
typical_rounds: Technical Panel Interview on Database & Java/Python

hiring_programs.name: GenC Next
hiring_programs.overview: Advanced programming, data structures, cloud fundamentals, and system troubleshooting.

hiring_programs.name: Software Developer
hiring_programs.overview: Rigorous on-paper and offline coding without standard libraries or IDEs. Application design and OOP mastery.
typical_rounds: Round 1: Basic Programming in C/Java/Python (Loops, Arrays, Math)
Round 2: Advanced Coding (Matrix, String algorithms, No IDE)
Round 3: Application Development (CLI app like Railway/ATM reservation)

hiring_programs.name: Elite National Talent Hunt
hiring_programs.overview: Aptitude, essay writing, coding logic, and foundational technical interview.
typical_rounds: NLTH Online Test (Aptitude, Written English, Coding)

hiring_programs.name: Turbo Track
hiring_programs.overview: Advanced coding questions, database queries, and object-oriented software engineering.

hiring_programs.name: Associate Software Engineer (ASE)
hiring_programs.overview: Cognitive & technical assessments, pseudocode analysis, and behavioral interview.

hiring_programs.name: Advanced ASE
hiring_programs.overview: Full stack, cloud architectures, and advanced data structure algorithms.

hiring_programs.name: Associate Analyst / Technology
hiring_programs.overview: Strong analytical problem solving, business case scenarios, SQL, and communication skills.
